data.narrative:
Strata Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Eric Zhou and Alex Mason that has raised $5.2M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of 9 peers (1 public, 8 private), including companies such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics, though narrow same-stage comparables remain limited.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable approach, using total capital raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement. This yields an implied valuation of $13M. A Peer-Median approach could not be reliably applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints within the robotics subsector—only one same-stage comparable was identified, falling short of the minimum three-company threshold required for statistical confidence.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $11M to $15M, with a median of $13M. This range reflects the mechanics of Stage-Progression applied to the $5.2M raised proxy, absent corroborating peer transaction data. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x multiplier for this specific sub-sector and stage, the absence of recent comparable Seed-stage robotics exits or Series A rounds, and limited visibility into Strata's current burn rate and runway. A second valuation method—either transaction comps or revenue multiples—would strengthen conviction in this range.
